# Informational Paragraph Builder

Subject: Writing
Grade band: 3-5
Resource type: Paragraph Frame
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards

## Short Description
A paragraph builder for topic sentences, facts, elaboration, and closing ideas.

## Alignment Note
Supports informative writing, organization, evidence, and elaboration.

## Classroom Use Case
Use after research note-taking to help students turn facts into a coherent paragraph.

## Preview Content
- Topic sentence
- Fact plus explain it
- Closing that teaches the reader

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
